iti94:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti94:2.1: tathā tathā bhikkhave bhikkhu upaparikkheyya yathā yathāssa upaparikkhato bahiddhā cassa viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ hoti avisaṭaṃ, ajjhattaṃ asaṇṭhitaṃ anupādāya na paritasseyya.
iti94:2.2: bahiddhā cassa bhikkhave viññāṇe avikkhitte avisaṭe sati ajjhattaṃ asaṇṭhite anupādāya aparitassato āyatiṃ jāti jarāmaraṇa dukkhasamudayasambhavo na hotī’ti.
iti94:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
